items.name: Wobbly Life
items.desc: Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

items.name: Escape From Duckov
items.desc: Escape from Duckov is a PVE indie survival RPG — in a duck's world!. Scavenge for resources, build your hideout, and upgrade your gear in the world of Duckov. Start from nothing and rise to the top. Outwit hostile ducks, survive, or make it out alive.

items.name: Alchemy Factory
items.desc: Start small, team up with friends, and automate production with conveyor belts, pipes, and magical devices. Stock your shop with potions, jewelry, and relics, complete commissions, and build an alchemy empire! Alchemy Factory 1.0 is out now with the Wagon Logistics System and revamped shopkeeping.

items.name: Hull Rupture
items.desc: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

items.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
items.desc: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

items.name: Nocturnal 2
items.desc: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

blocks.title: ③ 절대 규모 · 7일 리뷰 증가 수

items.name: Crime Scene Cleaner
items.desc: Once you get tangled with the mob, you will forever be a part of the mob. At least they pay a decent salary and all you have to do is clean up after their dirty work, but you know what you’re doing. So clean crime scenes, earn as much money as you can, and get ready for the next mission.

items.name: TCG Card Shop Simulator
items.desc: Open your own local game store. Stock shelves with the latest booster packs, or crack them and collect the cards for yourself. Set your own prices, hire staff, host events, and expand your card shop.

items.name: IdleOn - The Incremental MMO
items.sub: Lavaflame2 · Idler, Free to Play, Incremental
items.desc: The incremental idle MMO where your heroes keep fighting while you're gone! Spend their loot on upgrades, unlock classes from Elemental-Wizard to Cannon-Pirate, and level 20 unique skills like Farming, Sailing, and Construction!

items.name: Dressmaker
items.desc: Become a dressmaker! Choose fabric, cut out pattern pieces and sew them all together to make the dresses of your dreams - in this cozy crafting game, inspired by real dressmaking.

items.name: How to Fish
items.desc: A 1-4 player physics based fishing simulator. While drinking and boating you suddenly crash into a small island. To work your way back home you have to learn How to Fish.

items.name: over the hill
items.sub: Funselektor Labs Inc. · Driving, Co-op, Adventure
items.desc: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

items.name: Retro Rewind - Video Store Simulator
items.desc: Manage your very own video store in the early 90s! Rent, sell, decorate and expand your business from the ground up and relive the golden ages of video rentals!

items.name: One Million Coins
items.desc: A short, focused first-person incremental mining game. Dig through a vault of one million coins, bank your haul, buy better tools, and build an ever-faster gold-collecting operation.

items.name: Brick by Brick: Tidy Up the Small Town!
items.sub: PaperPixel Games · Casual, Simulation, Online Co-Op
items.desc: Brick By Brick is a relaxing tidy-up game you can play solo or co-op with up to 5 players. Collect, sort, and place 18,490 bricks to rebuild a charming town. Unlock helpful abilities and watch scattered piles become finished buildings. One brick at a time!

items.name: REKA
items.sub: Emberstorm Entertainment · Building, Character Customization, Indie

items.name: Japanese Ramen Simulator
items.sub: Wild Dog · Casual, Simulation, Early Access
items.desc: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

items.name: Order of the Sinking Star
items.desc: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

items.name: Wobbly Life
items.desc: Wobbly Life is a vibrant open-world physics sandbox. Play with your friends online or in local co-op, with exciting jobs, mini games and wacky story missions. Earn cash to spend in the world on clothes, vehicles and houses. There is a whole Wobbly World out there to explore!

items.name: Funeral for the Sun
items.desc: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

items.name: Safari-TV
items.sub: Mercy Games · Action, Adventure, Early Access
items.desc: Run a safari agency with friends in chaotic 2–4 player co-op. Drive a fully destructible, physics-based truck, take care of tourists, and survive wildlife encounters. Film the chaos, watch your videos together, and grow your in-game channel.

items.name: Finals Week ✍🏻
items.desc: A 1-4 player co-op cheating simulator where you and your friends try to survive the final week of exams. Steal answers, elude the teacher, and use every tool in your cheating arsenal to graduate from school without studying a single page.

items.name: Scritchy Scratchy
items.desc: Scritchy Scratchy is a super-satisfying scratch card incremental game. Buy stacks of scratch-offs, unlock auto-scratching, and chase massive jackpots. Will you play it safe or go all-in?

items.name: STARCINDER
items.desc: The stars are dying. Pilot an evolving warship across the Milky Way in this third-person 3D space roguelite. Fight interceptors, shatter asteroids, build your arsenal, and carry the last spark from Earth orbit to the far-side beacon.

items.name: Tidyspell
items.desc: Tidyspell is a cozy first person magic tidying game. Lift and place every object with your wand, catch invisible thieving spirits, fly on your broom, brew potions and step through doors into rooms that are bigger on the inside.

items.name: Shadow Mist Idle
items.desc: "Shadow Mist Idle" is a placeable pixel-style dark loot-grinding game. Build your skills through selectable talents and a vast array of unique equipment, and vanquish the hordes of enemies that come your way.

items.name: Coastal Cargo
items.desc: Coastal Cargo is a strategy simulation game about becoming the world's best Naval Logistician. Chart trade routes between ports in a sprawling archipelago. Drop boats, start transporting cargo, and earn your rewards. How long can your empire last in this ever more challenging environment?

items.name: Flexible Frosty
items.sub: Sleeping Panda Games · Adventure, Casual, Strategy
items.desc: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.
